label: A red and white blanket and a white shield over Taiwan
description: A white shield brought over Taiwan and a red and white blanket extended from the water toward China as they prayed, which he then matches to a report that Chinese air force activity around the island had fallen sharply with no fighters at all in a week, and calls the power of prayer. Daily incursions have varied for years, so a quiet week is within the ordinary range, which is the base rate the fulfilment claim runs against.
aliases: I saw a white shield and brought over Taiwan
It was red and white flannel and it looked like a blanket over Taiwan
DO YOU SEE THAT'S THE POWER OF PRAYER?

label: A scorpion rises out of the Gulf by Alabama and heads for Tennessee
description: A scorpion with its tail curled coming up out of the water of the Gulf at the Alabama and Mississippi border and heading toward Tennessee, given in the same session as the barge on the Mississippi and the device over Kentucky. Nothing observable is attached to the scorpion itself, so it can only be scored through the events it is placed alongside.
aliases: I SEE A SCORPION COMING UP OUT OF ALABAMA
A SCORPION COMING UP OUT OF THE WATER

label: Watch Israel in the middle of the night, worse than October 7th
description: An instruction to watch Israel in the middle of the night, repeated, with what is coming described as worse than October 7th, set alongside an uptick in the demonic and in the Mahdi material. The comparison gives a clear benchmark: the 2023 attack killed about twelve hundred people, so worse than that is a threshold that could not be missed.
aliases: Watch Israel in the middle of the night
I'm watching Israel in the middle of the night

label: Since the 23rd of last year the world is past the point of no return
description: The Lord saying that as of the 23rd of last year they entered the point of no return, with labour pains coming one after another: wars, then shakings and earthquakes, then pestilence and plagues, escalating so that each year looks chaotic. He does not say which month the 23rd falls in, which removes the date from an otherwise dated claim.
aliases: As of the 23rd of last year, you've entered into the point of no return
The labor pains are going to come one one one after another
birthing pains, BECAUSE THE BABY'S COMING

label: A horde of missiles held underground, kept back to fulfil their prophecy
description: A supply of missiles and something darker than any natural weapon held underneath the ground, not yet released, kept to fulfil what he calls their Quran prophecy, aimed at Israel and America but by his own reckoning ninety five or more per cent about Israel with America only in the way. He also declares in the same session that it will implode on them in their own base and that nothing they are planning will come to pass, which is the opposite outcome.

what's under the ground is darker than what anybody realize
they have not released it yet

label: Russia backs Iran the way America backed Ukraine, but on a greater scale
description: War games seen over the boats, and Russia doing for Iran what America did for Ukraine while denying involvement, only on a greater scale, using its satellites and equipment, with North Korea backing it because they want the oil and the rights. He says that without prayer this puts American troops in harm's way and will provoke the president.
